environment.attention: sdpa (xformers is not installed in this environment)

repeat: two runs from the same initial state, in one process, agreed bit for bit; run with --check to compare a new process
digests: SHA-256 of each tensor's exact bytes: contiguous, in its own dtype (shape and dtype are listed beside it), in memory order on this little-endian machine. grad_sha256 is the gradient after clipping and before the optimizer step; param_sha256 is the value after the optimizer step. The order is the recording's parameters.json, which equals the UNet's named_parameters order.

notes.output: the UNet's bfloat16 output under autocast; today's trainer's Accelerate wrapper casts it to float32, an exact cast
notes.grad_norm: clip_grad_norm_'s total norm, in bfloat16 as torch computes it from bfloat16 gradients; it is below max_grad_norm, so clipping multiplied every gradient by exactly 1 and is not exercised by this step
